title: malva fastigiata var. abulensis
intro: Malva fastigiata var. abulensis, commonly known as Mallow, is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Mallow include soothing irritated tissues, reducing inflammation, and acting as an expectorant to relieve congestion. The bioactive constituents of Mallow include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
